plain_answer: For system architects: choose a system, let the Workbench pick the weakest support point, stress-test it, repair one editable dependency, then export one before/after decision packet.
why_care: It helps decide whether one repair is worth deeper review by showing the failure path, recovery change, remaining uncertainty and export hash in one local packet.
default_path_narrative: Default path: Start -> Workbench -> stress test -> repair -> compare -> export. Wiki, graph, formulas and proof are optional detours from that path.
first_decision_surface: Workbench / Diagnose, stress-test, repair, compare and export

post_entry_continuity_contract.target_heading: Diagnose a system, break it, repair it, compare the result
post_entry_continuity_contract.expected_visible_result: After the cockpit CTA, the Workbench shows the selected starter system, the five-step repair loop, changed recovery/connectivity metrics, export hash and nonclaim boundary.

nonclaim_boundary: The first viewport promises local evaluation only: no upload, purchase, or proof-oracle action.
